content: In 1 John, what does John say God is?
explanation: Whoever does not love does not know God. “Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.” (1 John 4:8, BSB)

content: In 1 John, why should we love one another?
explanation: Everyone who loves knows God. “Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God.” (1 John 4:7, BSB)

content: In 1 John, how was God's love revealed among us?
explanation: So that we might live through Him. “God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.” (1 John 4:9, BSB)

content: In 1 John, love is not that we loved God, but that what?
explanation: God loved first. “not that we loved God, but that He loved us” (1 John 4:10, BSB)

content: In 1 John, since God so loved us, what ought we to do?
explanation: God's love flows through us. “Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.” (1 John 4:11, BSB)

content: In 1 John, what does perfect love drive out?
explanation: There is no fear in love. “There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear” (1 John 4:18, BSB)

content: In 1 John, why do we love?
explanation: Our love answers God's love. “We love because He first loved us.” (1 John 4:19, BSB)

content: In 1 John, whoever loves God must also love whom?
explanation: This is God's command. “Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.” (1 John 4:21, BSB)

content: In 1 John, what will God do if we confess our sins?
explanation: He is faithful and just. “If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins” (1 John 1:9, BSB)

content: In 1 John, what has the Father's love made us?
explanation: And that is what we are! “that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are!” (1 John 3:1, BSB)

content: In 1 John, God is light, and in Him there is no what?
explanation: This is the message from Him. “God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.” (1 John 1:5, BSB)

content: In 1 John, if anyone sins, who is our advocate before the Father?
explanation: He is the Righteous One. “we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.” (1 John 2:1, BSB)

content: In 1 John, we should love not only in word, but in what?
explanation: Real love acts. “Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.” (1 John 3:18, BSB)

content: In 1 John, what are believers told not to love?
explanation: The Father's love must come first. “Do not love the world or anything in the world.” (1 John 2:15, BSB)

content: In 1 John, why did John write to believers?
options: So they know they have eternal life
explanation: Believers can be sure. “so that you may know that you have eternal life.” (1 John 5:13, BSB)

content: In 1 John, what is someone who says he loves God but hates his brother?
explanation: Love for God shows in love for others. “If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar.” (1 John 4:20, BSB)

content: How does the letter of 1 John end?
explanation: A final warning to his little children. “Little children, keep yourselves from idols.” (1 John 5:21, BSB)

content: In 1 John, no one has ever seen God, but if we love one another, what happens?
explanation: His love is perfected in us. “but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.” (1 John 4:12, BSB)

content: In 1 John, perfected love gives us confidence on which day?
explanation: We are like Him in this world. “so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment” (1 John 4:17, BSB)
